rows.note: Use this for a version or form that has been made simpler, rather than for the act or process itself.

example.english: This simplification of the contract makes it quicker to read.
example.traditional: 呢份係合約嘅簡化版，方便你快啲睇完。

rows.note: Use this for the act or process of making something simpler, especially in formal or written contexts; it is the all-purpose abstract term for that slice.

example.english: This simplification of the procedures has greatly shortened the application time.
example.traditional: 今次手續簡化，大大縮短咗申請時間。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 sau2 zuk6 gaan2 faa3 daai6 daai6 suk1 dyun2 zo2 san1 cing2 si4 gaan1
